status_effects.explanation: The narrator's ironic comparison of Swann's romantic anguish to trivial physical or appetitive matters locally undercuts his dignity and self-possession.

appraisal_events.evidence: une philosophie positive, presque médicale... Swann trouvait sage de faire dans sa vie la part de la souffrance qu'il éprouvait à ignorer ce qu'avait fait Odette, aussi bien que la part de la recrudescence qu'un climat humide causait à son eczéma... comme celui des collections et de la bonne cuisine.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator ironically frames Swann's resigned, pseudo-medical rationalization of his jealous suffering as a routine budgeted habit, equating it with a skin ailment and a taste for fine food, which quietly mocks his self-serious composure.
